Requirement stability.why: Power and cooling targets are fixed; scheduling rules may change.

Regulatory criticality.why: CERT-In, BRSR Core and AI risk rules all apply.

Security risk.why: Multi-tenant GPU cloud with personal data in prompts.

Project complexity.why: Grid, cooling and tenant software interact.

System size.why: 40 MW campus with several GPU halls.

Expected change frequency.why: Demand-response and AI rules are still evolving.

Need for continuous delivery.why: Scheduler and portal ship often; plant changes rarely.

Testing and documentation formality.why: Audits need test reports and metered evidence.

Need for formal verification.why: Ride-through must be tested, not proven formally.

Failure consequence.why: Outages hit many tenants and the grid.
